decision: A process-wide observer at both outer native rebind entries can enclose their existing native mutation intervals. Observing only BDX Event27, a thunk registration or the five inner STATUS calls cannot provide that boundary. This research installs no hook and grants no Journal/transaction admission.

abi.roots: RCX=Actor*, EDX=uint32 parameter ID; preserved RBX/RDI; one ordinary RET per root, no outer tail exit. After acquisition returns Actor+0x5c0 always receives its result; STATUS+0x268 receives the encoded Actor only for a nonnull result. Return RAX is incidental and unused by the recorded script route; do not invent a stable semantic return value.
abi.adapters: RCX points to a local tagged8-byte vector. operand0.low32 -> DecodeNullable -> p; *(uint32*)(p+4) -> DecodeNullable -> Actor. operand1.low32 -> EDX. Restore adapter stack then tail jump.
abi.descriptors: bank2 root753490+0x10 ->756B60. Index9 argc3 ->431A70 ->411350. Index95 argc2 ->431AA0 ->4112B0. Both return-slot bits clear. Canonical trap words are008A 0009 and008A 005F; these are static decode examples, not a shipped-script witness.

conditions: Actor uses the batched motion branch rather than the earlier synchronous branch.
A newly present flagged motion event is delivered and its BDX context contains event27.
Executed bytecode selects bank2,index9 or95 and builds the required valid operand vector. The third condition has no retail asset witness in this set.
provenance.otherRoutes: 41B400 has direct calls from3E1C80 and3E1410. Its rdata xref6EF8B0 is chained unwind metadata, not another callback registration. Both rebind roots have exactly one recorded direct code caller (their adapters); exact8-byte PE searches find each adapter in one descriptor and no direct root pointer constants. This does not exclude computed or encoded aliases.

normalClosure.scope: Both roots and adapters, all normal direct/tail descendants plus the fixed3EBF20 bsearch callback. All original bodies/bytes are included.
external: bsearch with fixed 3EBF20 comparator, nonzero key, valid table/count and all other CRT parameter preconditions
normalClosure.result: No ordinary engine SwitchToFiber/yield or longjmp transfer appears in this bounded closure under the named external API contracts, including a nonzero bsearch key and valid parameters. Native waits can be unbounded. Entry from a fiber remains possible; no ordinary yield is found while a rebind frame is open under those preconditions.
normalClosure.limits: ID0 becomes a null bsearch key and may enter the external invalid-parameter handler; that path is unclosed and has no no-yield/normal-return claim. External DLL implementations/modifications, abnormal SEH/C++ paths, debugger/VEH rewrites and native injection are not covered by this normal-path graph.

exceptionBoundary.rootAndAdapterFlags: All four have one full-extent pdata record with UNWIND version1, flags0. This means no local language handler metadata; it does not mean no exception can propagate.
exceptionBoundary.transitive: 4AD2C0 has termination flag2. Interpreter has a primary handler record plus a chained record; neither makes rebind completion failure-safe. Language-specific unwind handlers were not fully closed.
implementationRequirements: Begin observation before calling either original, before the old STATUS is read/released; invalidate Actor binding before entry.
Preserve exact input ABI and native return register behavior; retain root frame/trampoline unwind correctness.
Support calls from any native thread with per-thread nesting. Do not hold a tracker lock while native calls or CRT waits run.
End normally only after original RET; distinguish abnormal unwind and fault/invalidate rather than publishing a completed binding.
Keep ordinary entry forwarding available on permanent observation faults. Bootstrap must separately drain preexisting calls; this package does not implement publication/drain.
Cover constructor, retirement, parking and bulk/alias paths separately before any compare/write transaction admission.

validationLimits: Neither the interpreter trap branch nor the two adapters validate the assumed types and pointer chain. Malformed script state can dereference invalid memory; a root observer alone starts after adapter decoding and cannot guard that earlier fault.
Bank root and descriptors reside in writable data. Two visible setters only change bank9, but computed/bulk writes and external mods are not excluded.
Native error status5 handles selected invalid opcode cases; it is not general validation for invalid trap indices, insufficient operands or null pointers.
No installed hooks, product changes, live game operations or IDB changes.

At 3EBF44 the parameter ID is sign-extended into the pointer-valued bsearch key. ID0 is a null key; the documented CRT invalid-parameter handler can run before any fallback. The retry with key0x45 is reached only if the first bsearch returns null.
pagination: Fresh interpreter ASM:4 pages,1094 instructions; pseudocode:300+300+295=895 lines. Tool marks every partial pseudocode page truncated=true, including the final page; exact counts plus monotone next cursors and done establish aggregation. Original per-page flags are preserved. All direct xrefs, imports and exact-pointer searches completed without continuation.
nextWork: Identify extracted retail BDX event27/finalizer bytecode reaching bank2 entries9/95; trace operand0 construction and its p+4 Actor provenance.
Observe all Actor construction/rebind/retirement paths with proven identity and lifetime boundaries before enabling dependent mutations.
Audit the broad native trap argument/error contract separately before using the VM to drive trainer commands.
Complete exception-handler closure or retain conservative permanent-fault semantics for abnormal unwinds.
